note: Gujjar Home Class versions. kid / par = homeclass-kid.html KID_VER / homeclass.html PAR_VER, kidApk / parApk = APK versionCode. Every open page checks this every minute and updates itself. Add a news line (k kid|par|all, v = the new version of that kind) with every change, newest first.

news.t: 🛠️ Fixed: a new class could get stuck on "Welcome" if started right after another. Tables said right but heard slightly wrong (e.g. 3 as "thirty three") are asked again, never marked wrong.
✏️ Spelling: the word now pops up exactly when the app says it back ("bones is spelt B, O, N, E, S") and stays until it finishes. In Mom / Dad mode the letters show as you spell.
✏️ Spelling: you can now see what the app reads - each letter pops up as you say it (green = right, amber = sounds alike, red = different), and the word pops up big with "I heard" when you finish.
✏️ Spelling: while you spell, the screen now shows only the letters that fit the word (dots for the rest) - no more strange letters like "E S" for S.

✏️ Spelling: ⏭ Skip button (or say "skip"); Mom / Dad mode now finds the word from the letters; M, N, S and other letters are followed better. If the app is not sure it asks again - it never says "Not quite" on a doubtful hearing.
✏️ Spelling: N ("en") and other letters are followed much better - tested on Vihaan's own recordings. If the app is not sure, it asks again and never says "Not quite".
✏️ Spelling hears letters much better (tested on Vihaan's own recordings): "b o n e s" now comes out right even with talking around.
✏️ Spelling: other words the app hears (room talk, "yes") are ignored - only the letters count. New ⌫ Clear button to throw away what it heard and spell again.
✏️ Spellings: the app now hears letters properly (it was missing them), shows the letters live, and has 3 ways: 📖 show the words, 🙈 app says the word, 👨‍👩‍👦 Mom / Dad says any word.
📝 Each lesson is a separate class: ▶ Start it on 🏠 Home, give it its own time and days, or switch on 🔀 "Also after the tables" to mix it in.

📝 Lessons are their own classes now (▶ on Home, or their own time) - not mixed with the tables unless you switch on 🔀. Tables are said the parents' way: "1 eight ja 8". The app listens better for each answer (e.g. 12).
🗣️ Saying the table fast is followed better (tested on Vihaan's own voice). A line the app did not catch is asked alone - no whole table again. 📦 App h23 is only 6 MB; updates download on Wi-Fi.
🎙️ App h22: when you say a whole table, the sound is saved so we can make the listening understand you better.
📱 The table now fits the phone screen - no scrolling, on the 📖 table page and while saying the table.
🗣️ Saying the table fast works now: "5 one 5, 5 two 10 …" without "ja" is understood, and if you go back and say a line again, your latest one counts.
📚 Practise a table 4 ways: 📖 just show it (study alone), 🗣️ say it with the app, 👀 say it with the answers shown, 🙈 test without seeing - with ▶ Start saying / ■ Done.
🙈 Test a table from your phone: Home → the child's card → pick the table - the kids phone starts the test without seeing.
App h21: the app no longer closes at the first answer - the new offline listening now works on the phone.
📥 App updates show every step on screen: checking, downloading with a progress bar (% and MB), installing, done.
⟳ Check for update now checks the app too and shows both (screen and app version); the app asks again every 3 minutes until it has the newest one.
App h17: fixes the app closing by itself at the first answer; if the new listening engine ever fails, the phone switches to the old listening by itself.

🗣️ Say the whole table: Vihaan says the table non-stop (5 one ja 5, 5 two ja 10 ...), the app follows every line, tells him exactly which line was wrong or missed, practises it with him, then asks for the whole table once more.
🎤 New offline listening engine that only listens for table words - much better at fast speech, no internet needed (app h16).
🎤 Big answer button always at the bottom right (thumb): hold it while answering or tap once and speak. Press it any time - the app stops talking and listens.
✋ Hold to answer: press and hold the big button while answering, let go when done - only that is heard and it checks at once. (⚙️ → 🎙 Hands-free to switch back.)
Short answers understood even when Google writes a sound-alike ("the" for three, "to" for two, "ate" for eight).
🎤 Listens through pauses ("five ten… ja… fifty"), waits quietly until you start, and stray words are not marked wrong - it just listens again.
Each question comes only once per round. 🎤 When Google's internet listening fails, the phone's offline listening takes over.
🎤 A soft ding + "Your turn!" shows when to answer; a short pause no longer makes it talk; if Google is unsure (52 or 72?) it asks "Did you say 72? Say it again."
Fixed: after a quick answer the next question stopped listening by itself and the class ran on too fast ("Are you there?").
🩺 Each phone and the TV keep their own log for 24 hours: ⚙️ → 🩺 Log (shown only when you tap it, with 📋 Copy).
🎤 Listening fixed on Xiaomi phones: a fresh microphone listener for every answer, restarted by itself if it does not start.
🔊 "📱 Phone only (Google Home off)" is clearer, and the Google Home now plays the phone's own voice - if it does not start in 6 seconds, the phone speaks at once.
Fixed: a short answer like "eight" was shown but not taken ("Are you there?") - now it counts.
Google Home: if the speaker does not answer, the phone speaks at once instead of waiting.
📺 The TV can now ⏹ Stop the class that runs on the phone, and pressing ▶ twice no longer starts it twice.
Update messages close by themselves after 15 seconds (or tap them).
📺 TV practice: speak into the remote (the app opens the remote's microphone itself) - or type with the number keys, whichever is first.
Clearer app-update messages: what to press, and no repeated "downloading".
Fixed: 🏠 Home on the "Well done" screen now goes home at once.
Tables the way you say them: "two one ja two", "2 too ja four", "2 into 3 is 6" are understood now. One perfect round finishes a table.
📺 On the TV, ▶ starts the class on the kids phone (it listens) and the TV shows the big table board. ✍️ Practise with the remote is still there.
Settings: a table is finished after 1 perfect round (or choose 2).
App updates now install at once (only a running class waits) and the app opens again by itself or with one tap on "✅ updated".

🔊 Speaker page like the staff app: Auto / Always Google Home / Phone, speed 🐢 Slower to 🚀 Fastest, class volume, words on TV, Test and Stop. The Google Home is now made ready before the class, so the first sentence no longer waits.
Settings → Devices → 🔊: change a kids device's speaker, speed and volume from your phone.
🔊 New: speak on your Google Home over Wi-Fi - ⚙️ (top right) → 🔊 Speaker → 🏠 Google Home, pick it, done. No Bluetooth needed.
The device list shows which Google Home each kids device speaks on.
Fixed: the home screen could stop working after the first class (Back did nothing, ▶ Start from Mom / Dad's phone was not heard).
Reports read the table progress correctly.
🩺 Every device now keeps a short log (Settings → 🩺 Diagnostics, 📋 Copy) so problems can be found fast.
A phone or TV that was set up as a separate family joins the main family by itself.
▶ Start and 📣 Call from Mom's / Dad's phone now open the class even when the kids phone is locked or Home Class is in the background.
When the kids phone does not answer ▶ Start, the message now says exactly what to do.
Updates now arrive by themselves within a minute, and this card shows what changed.
Fixed: ➕ Add a device was stuck on "Making a code…"; a newly linked device shows at once.
Faster and steadier connection to the database.
Parent app for Android: speak to type and hear questions in the phone's own voice.
📋 Table board: the whole table on screen and on the TV, rows turn green as he answers, his words appear live.
